gloss: fan activity; supporting one's favorite idol/character

definitions.gloss: fan activity; supporting one's favorite idol, character, or celebrity
definitions.explanation: Activities done to support and show dedication to one's {推|お}し (favorite person or character), such as attending concerts, buying merchandise, or promoting on social media.

examples.japanese: {推|お}し{活|かつ}のためにお{金|かね}を{貯|た}めている。
examples.english: I'm saving money for fan activities.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{推|お}し{活|かつ}でライブに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to a concert this weekend for fan activities.

examples.japanese: {推|お}し{活|かつ}を{通|とお}じて{友達|ともだち}ができた。
examples.english: I made friends through fan activities.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
Abbreviation of {推|お}し{活動|かつどう}, following the modern Japanese trend of ～{活|かつ} words:
・{就活|しゅうかつ} (job hunting)
・{婚活|こんかつ} (spouse hunting)
・{終活|しゅうかつ} (end-of-life planning)

KEY CONCEPT:
・{推|お}し refers to one's favorite idol, character, or celebrity
・{推|お}し{活|かつ} encompasses all activities to support them

COMMON ACTIVITIES:
・ライブ{参戦|さんせん} (attending concerts)
・グッズ{購入|こうにゅう} (buying merchandise)
・SNSで{布教|ふきょう} (promoting on social media)
・{聖地巡礼|せいちじゅんれい} (visiting related locations)
